notes: Followed the skill as written; five passes in one shared context. Friction: (1) Phase order says literature check after the five reports, but the claim IDs and queries are needed earlier, and a single-context run cannot truly separate them; I ran the searches after reading the paper and before writing the reports and disclosed this. (2) The EIC weights were fixed in scores.json and the AFTER aggregation was run before the meta-review text was written, because the aggregate numbers are needed to fill the template; the order in the skill (verify, weight, then rerun) is easy to blur. (3) The skill does not say whether scripts/integrity_scan.py may be run under the evaluation's tool limits; I did a manual search for reviewer-directed text instead and said so. (4) related_search.py: 5-word queries are refused even when they are hyphenated (test-time counts as 2 words), and arXiv keyword search returned mostly off-topic hits, so coverage/scout/novelty were not run (the novelty profile was rated by hand). (5) pool_position vs Overall rule (Overall 4 needs pool >= 65) forced R3/R4 to 66 while the script's pool band for 66 is [55,61] relative to dimension composites of about 62; the two tables for pool bands in rubrics (62-72 for 70-84) and in the script are inconsistent in the 62-70 range. (6) The DA-CRITICAL decision table for criterion 3 is long; the ARC masking choice fits row 2 (best-scoring and headline, but main claim holds at the other value), which gave MAJOR.
